messages.subject: NIMBLE help
parts:
Hi everyone,

I've never used Nimble before and I'm trying to complete a simple survival analysis on a tester dataset which contains 5 time steps and 8 individuals. However, I keep encountering the same error describing a problem with variable z. I've attached the code and error below. Any help would be appreciated! Code:

#Testing#
set.seed(123)
# Create dataframe with 9 rows and 6 columns
data <- matrix(sample(0:1, 9 * 5, replace = TRUE), nrow = 9)
# Add id numbers from 1 to 9 as the first column
data <- cbind(id = 1:9, data)
# Set column names
colnames(data) <- c("id", paste0("winter", 1:5))
# Convert matrix to dataframe
tester <- as.data.frame(data)
# Print the dataframe
print(tester)
#Code#
mrc.caigual <- nimbleCode({
  phi ~ dunif(0, 1) # Prior survival is unknown so we generate it
  p ~ dunif(0, 1) # Prior detection is unknown so we generate it
 
  # Define parameters
  gamma[1, 1] <- phi # Probability of surviving a to b
  gamma[1, 2] <- 1 - phi # Probability of dying from a to b
  gamma[2, 1] <- 0 # Probability of coming back to life a to b
  gamma[2, 2] <- 1 # Probability of staying dead a to b
  delta[1] <- 1 # Probability of being alive at a
  delta[2] <- 0 # Probability of being dead at a
  omega[1, 1] <- 1 - p # Probability of being alive and not-detected
  omega[1, 2] <- p # Probability of being alive and detected
  omega[2, 1] <- 1 # Probability of being dead and not detected
  omega[2, 2] <- 0 # Probability of being dead and detected
 
  # Define likelihood
  for (i in 1:N) {
    z[i, first[i]] ~ dcat(delta[1:2])
    for (j in (first[i] + 1):T) {
      z[i, j] ~ dcat(gamma[z[i, j - 1], 1:2])
      y[i, j] ~ dcat(omega[z[i, j], 1:2])
    }
  }
})

# Define your binary data 
tester <- matrix(sample(0:1, 5 * 5, replace = TRUE), nrow = 5)
tester <- as.data.frame(tester)

# Obtain 'first' and other necessary constants
first <- apply(tester, 1, function(x) min(which(x != 0)))
N <- nrow(tester)
T <- ncol(tester)

# Constants and data object
my.constants <- list(N = N, T = T, first = first)
my.data <- list(y = tester)

# Initial values
initial.values <- function() list(phi = runif(1, 0, 1), p = runif(1, 0, 1), z = tester + 1)

# Monitors
parameters.to.save <- c("phi", "p")

# MCMC run
mcmc.output <- nimbleMCMC(code = mrc.caigual,
                          constants = my.constants,
                          data = my.data,
                          inits = initial.values,
                          monitors = parameters.to.save,
                          niter = 5000,
                          nburnin = 1000,
                          nchains = 2)

Error: Defining model
Error in genVarInfo3() :
  dimensions specified are smaller than model specification for variable 'z'

Many thanks,
George

messages.author: f97d21be02e5ed9b
messages.subject: Re: NIMBLE help
parts:
Hey George,

The problem is in your constant called first[i]. When i = 5, first = Inf, which causes the error that you see. 

-Heather
